evals.prompt: I need a sourced note on what a 1970s British police radio call sounded like, for an audio-drama cue. Do not write the scene. If you cannot fetch a source, say the note cannot be filed.
evals.expected_output: Either a research note with a real source and citation, or an explicit refusal to file an unsourced note. Not an audio-drama script.

evals.prompt: The library already has a note: 'Victorian mourning colors were black, then mauve. Source: British Library blog, https://example.com/mourning'. The author asks what color a widow wore the year after the funeral, for a short story. Do not browse.
evals.expected_output: An answer that cites the existing note and does not create a second unsourced note or a short-story paragraph.
